decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The existing hedgeing on the northwest boundary shall be protected during the installation of the fence and retained thereafter. 

If any retained hedging is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, it shall be replaced by a specimen of the same size and species and shall be planted at the next available planting season.
Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place until details of the proposed gates have been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place until details of a maintenance scheme for the hedge, fence and gates has been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Proposed erection of boundary fence and gates to part of northern boundary.
